extension.description: IntelliJ/WebStorm-style run configurations for npm and Flutter: a run selector in the status bar, a floating Run/Debug Configurations dialog with detected Node.js runtimes and package managers, Ctrl+R to run and import from IntelliJ.
debugger.label: npm (Run Configuration)
attr.packageJson: package.json whose directory is the working directory.
attr.command: Package manager command: run, start, test, install…
attr.arguments: Extra arguments. With npm, `--` is added before them automatically.
attr.nodeRuntime: Absolute path of the node binary. Empty: project default (.nvmrc, `runConfigurations.defaultNodeRuntime` or PATH).
attr.packageManager: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or a path. Empty: from the packageManager field or the lockfile.
attr.allowMultiple: Start a new instance instead of restarting the running one.
snippet.label: npm: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.description: Runs a package.json script with a chosen Node.js runtime and package manager.
settings.defaultNodeRuntime: Node binary used when a configuration's **Node runtime** is *Project* and there is no `.nvmrc`/`.node-version`. Empty: the `node` on PATH.
settings.showStatusBar: Show the run configuration selector and the Run/Debug/Stop buttons in the status bar.
settings.offerIntellijImport: Offer to import IntelliJ npm run configurations (`.idea/workspace.xml`, `.idea/runConfigurations`, `.run`) when a workspace has none.
debugger.flutter.label: Flutter (Run Configuration)
attr.program: Dart entrypoint of the application (e.g. lib/main.dart).
attr.flavor: Build flavor: a Gradle product flavor or an Xcode custom scheme.
snippet.flutter.label: Flutter: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.flutter.description: Runs a Flutter app through the Dart extension, with flavor and extra flutter run arguments.
settings.floatingDialog: Open the Run/Debug Configurations dialog in its own floating window, like IntelliJ. Off: as an editor tab.
attr.deviceId: Device to run on. Empty: the device chosen with *Select Flutter Device…* (or the Dart extension's).
debugger.script.label: Script (Run Configuration)
attr.interpreter: Interpreter command with its options. Empty: chosen from the extension (.py → venv/.venv Python or python3, .sh → bash, .js → node).
attr.workingDir: Working directory. Empty: the script's directory.
snippet.script.label: Run Configuration: Script
snippet.script.description: Runs a Python or shell script, like IntelliJ's Python / Shell Script configurations.
config.npmConsole: Where npm configurations print their output.
config.npmConsole.debugConsole: Debug Console, like IntelliJ's Run window (output of all processes, colours kept).
debugger.compound.label: Compound (Run Configuration)
attr.configurations: Names of the configurations (same folder) started together.
snippet.compound.label: Compound: Run Configurations Together (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.compound.description: Starts several run configurations at once.
settings.runWindow: Show the output of run configurations in the **Run** window (Services panel), with one tab per run, like IntelliJ. npm configurations printing to the integrated terminal (`runConfigurations.npmConsole`) keep their output there.
task.packageJson: package.json whose directory the script runs in.
attr.beforeLaunch: Steps run in order before launching (IntelliJ's *Before launch*): `config` (another configuration, waits until it ends), `npm` (a package.json script), `task` (a VS Code task) and `browser` (opens a URL). A failing step cancels the launch.
settings.codeLens: Show **▷ Run | Debug** above `package.json` scripts, Dart `main()`, Python `if __name__ == "__main__"` and shell scripts, like IntelliJ's gutter icons. Running one creates a temporary configuration (the last 5 are kept) unless an equivalent configuration exists.
attr.group: Folder of the configuration in the Run/Debug Configurations list and the Services view.
attr.envFile: `.env` file (dotenv format) loaded before launch; `env` overrides its variables.
settings.confirmRerun: Ask before stopping and rerunning a configuration that is already running (IntelliJ's *Stop and Rerun?*). The Run window's Rerun button never asks.
debugger.node.label: Node.js (Run Configuration)
debugger.attach.label: Attach to Node.js (Run Configuration)
debugger.test.label: Jest / Vitest (Run Configuration)
debugger.docker.label: Docker Compose (Run Configuration)
attr.node.workingDir: Working directory; empty: the file's directory.
attr.test.workingDir: Project directory (with package.json); empty: the nearest one above the test file.
attr.test.name: Suite or test name (`-t`); empty: the whole file.
snippet.node.label: Node.js: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.node.description: Runs a JavaScript/TypeScript file with the project's node.
snippet.attach.label: Attach to Node.js (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.attach.description: Attaches the debugger to a process started with --inspect.
snippet.test.label: Jest / Vitest: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.test.description: Runs a test file, suite or test with the project's runner.
snippet.docker.label: Docker Compose: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.docker.description: docker compose up of a compose file, with services and options.
